data.title: Secret gates pass forms that hide the commit or push from the text filter
data.description: Text gates cannot see every spelling: interpreters, scripts, git-run commands, spelled-apart verbs. Secrets can commit unscanned. Native git hooks are the planned fix.
data.repro: 1. Stage a synthetic key. 2. Run a listed form such as a script calling git. 3. Gate exits 0. Full list in the evidence.
data.expected: Spec Security: secret scan on commit and push
data.actual: Listed forms pass with no scan.
data.evidence: .workflow/evidence/sqlite-bug-tracker/attempt-5/e6.md DEF-E6-03; security round 5 in the feature Log row 30

data.title: Trace scrub keeps advisory text when marker lines end in CRLF
data.description: mem.py strips text between advisory marker lines only when the lines end in LF. With CRLF line endings the marked block, figures included, is written to the captured trace, which game projects commit.
data.repro: 1. Capture assistant text with CRLF lines: Before, the begin marker, a figure line, the end marker, After. 2. Read the trace line. Hits 1/1. Two expectedFailure tests in test_mem.py AdvisoryScrubEdgeTest.
data.expected: Marked block replaced by the pointer for any line ending (design spec, Advisory store, Traces)
data.actual: The block and its figure stay in the trace; LF input strips correctly
data.evidence: .workflow/evidence/game-production-agent/attempt-1/qa-report.md F1; mem.py RX_ADVISORY_BLOCK ends each marker in [ 	]*$

data.title: adv.py ingest crashes on JSON that is not an object
data.description: adv.py ingest calls dict methods on the parsed JSON without checking its type, so an array, null, a number, or a non-string return exits with an AttributeError traceback instead of a refusal.
data.repro: 1. In a repo that ignores .memory/advisory/, pipe [1,2] into adv.py ingest. 2. Also null, 7, and {agent: x, return: 7}. Hits 4/4. One expectedFailure test in test_adv.py AdvEdgeTest.
data.expected: A refusal on stderr with exit 2 and nothing stored, like other bad input (adv.py main)
